problem_identification.critical_issue: Persisting-L2 carve-out set once at init and never restored, leaking device-global state
problem_identification.root_cause: l2_init_impl() calls cudaDeviceSetLimit(cudaLimitPersistingL2CacheSize, prop.persistingL2CacheMaxSize) under std::call_once, invoked from ModelNew.__init__ via ext.l2_persist_init(). This raises the device-wide persisting-L2 reservation (18MB -> 60MB) permanently; nothing ever restores the previous limit or calls cudaCtxResetPersistingL2Cache, so the state outlives forward and slows unrelated/reference work.
problem_identification.trigger_condition: Any run: the extension's l2_persist_init() executes at module/ModelNew construction and sets the device limit once, outside forward, with no unwind path.
must_hold_invariants: cudaLimitPersistingL2CacheSize must equal its pre-forward value when forward returns
Any persisting window set inside forward must be released via cudaCtxResetPersistingL2Cache before return
No device-global limit may be configured from a static initializer or __init__
problem_identification.minimal_fix: Delete the cudaDeviceSetLimit(cudaLimitPersistingL2CacheSize,...) in l2_init_impl and the l2_persist_init() call in __init__; set g_persist_cap=0 so use_window stays false (base plain-launch path).
